entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸສ້າງໃຫມ່
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code CREATING. It reads "new parcel created".

entries.wording: ລໍຖ້າສາຂາ(ຕົ້ນທາງ)ກົດຮັບ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code REQUESTED. Waiting for the origin branch to accept the parcel.

entries.wording: ຢືນຢັນລົງສາຂາ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code CONFIRM_BY_SHIPPER. The sender confirmed dropping the parcel at a branch.

entries.wording: ໄລເດີ່ກຳລັງອອກໄປຮັບ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code ADD_SHIPPER. A rider is heading out to collect the parcel.

entries.wording: ໄຮເດີຮັບເຄື່ອງແລ້ວ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code RIDER_APPROVED. The rider collected the goods.

entries.wording: ສາຂາຕົ້ນທາງຮັບແລ້ວ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code ORIGIN_BRANCH_RECEIVED. The origin branch received the parcel.

entries.wording: ສາຂາຕົ້ນທາງຮັບພັດສະດຸແລ້ວ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code ORIGIN_BRANCH_RECEIVED_FORWARD. The origin branch received the parcel.

entries.wording: ກຳລັງຂົນສົ່ງໄປປາຍທາງ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code TRANSIT_TO_DEST_BRANCH. In transit to the destination branch.

entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸໄປສຳນັກງານໃຫຍ່
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code TRANSIT_TO_OFFICE. The parcel is going to the head office.

entries.wording: ຮອດສາຂາປາຍທາງເເລ້ວ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code DEST_BRANCH_RECEIVED_FORWARD. The parcel reached the destination branch, where the recipient collects it; the page counts the days it has waited there.

entries.wording: ຮອດປາຍທາງ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code DELIVER_TO_THE_ADDRESS. At the destination branch with a rider's delivery to the address asked for; the page shows it as arrived.

entries.wording: ໄລເດີ້ກຳລັງຈັດສົ່ງ...
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code RECEIVING_ORDERS. A rider is delivering the parcel.

entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸສົ່ງເຖິງທີ່ຖືກຕີກັບ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code IS_BACKWARD_FOR_CUSTOMER. The parcel the rider took out came back to the branch.

entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸສົ່ງສຳເລັດ
entries.note: The bill's status once the recipient has the parcel, seen live; the wording is its label in the carrier's tracker bundle. A bill marked as going back keeps this code once the sender has it, under another label.

entries.wording: ສົ່ງຄືນແມ່ຄ້າສຳເລັດແລ້ວ
entries.note: The page's label for a completed bill marked as going back: the sender has the parcel again.

entries.wording: ກຳລັງຕີກັບສາຂາຕົ້ນທາງ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code TRANSIT_TO_ORIGIN_BRANCH. The parcel is being sent back to the origin branch.

entries.wording: ຕີກັບຮອດສາຂາຕົ້ນທາງແລ້ວ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code ORIGIN_BRANCH_RECEIVED_BACKWARD. The returned parcel reached the origin branch.

entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸເສຍຫາຍ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code LOST. The label says the parcel is damaged; the code says lost.

entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸລ໋ອກສາຍ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code LOCKED. The parcel is held.

entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸຖຶກຍືດ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code RECEIVED_CONFISCATED. The parcel was seized.

entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸຜິດກົດໝາຍ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code RECEIVED_LAWLESS. The parcel was flagged as unlawful.

entries.wording: ຍົກເລິກແລ້ວ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code CANCELED. Cancelled.

entries.wording: ຖືກຍົກເລິກ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code CANCEL_BY_ADMIN. Cancelled by Anousith.

entries.wording: ພັດສະດຸຖືກສ້າງເເລ້ວ
entries.note: A label in the carrier's tracker bundle for status code DUPLICATE. "Parcel already created": a bill entered twice, which says nothing about where the parcel is.

entries.wording: ລໍຖ້າສາຂາຮັບເຄື່ອງ
entries.note: The tracking page's timeline label for the bill's creation date, which comes without a code. Waiting for a branch to take the parcel in.

entries.wording: ຢູ່ສາຂາຕົ້ນທາງ
entries.note: The tracking page's timeline label for the bill's origin branch's receipt date, which comes without a code. At the origin branch.

entries.wording: ກຳລັງຍ້າຍໄປສາຂາປາຍທາງ
entries.note: The tracking page's timeline label for the bill's origin branch's dispatch date, which comes without a code. Moving to the destination branch.

entries.wording: ຮອດສາຂາປາຍທາງແລ້ວ
entries.note: The tracking page's timeline label for the bill's destination branch's receipt date, which comes without a code. At the destination branch, where the recipient collects it.

entries.wording: ຈັດສົ່ງສຳເລັດແລ້ວ
entries.note: The tracking page's timeline label for the bill's completion date, which comes without a code. Delivered.

entries.wording: ກຳລັງຍ້າຍໄປສາຂາຕົ້ນທາງ (ເຄື່ອງຕີກັບ)
entries.note: The tracking page's timeline label for the bill's destination branch's dispatch date, which comes without a code. Moving back to the origin branch.

entries.wording: ຮອດສາຂາຕົ້ນທາງແລ້ວ
entries.note: The tracking page's timeline label for the bill's return's arrival date, which comes without a code. Back at the origin branch.

entries.wording: ສົ່ງຄືນແມ່ຄ້າສຳເລັດແລ້ວ
entries.note: The tracking page's timeline label for the bill's completion date on a bill marked as going back, which comes without a code. Handed back to the sender.

entries.wording: ສະແກນເຂົ້າ
entries.note: A scan's status SCAN_IN with direction FORWARD, under the tracking page's wording for it, seen live. Scanned in at a branch or centre.

entries.wording: ສະແກນອອກ
entries.note: A scan's status SCAN_OUT with direction FORWARD, under the tracking page's wording for it, seen live. Scanned out of a branch or centre.

entries.wording: ສົ່ງສຳເລັດ
entries.note: A scan's status COMPLETED with direction FORWARD, under the tracking page's wording for it, seen live. Handed over at the destination branch.

entries.wording: ສະແກນເຂົ້າ (ເຄື່ອງຕີກັບ)
entries.note: A scan's status SCAN_IN with direction BACKWARD, under the tracking page's wording for it. The page marks the scans of a parcel on its way back.

entries.wording: ສະແກນອອກ (ເຄື່ອງຕີກັບ)
entries.note: A scan's status SCAN_OUT with direction BACKWARD, under the tracking page's wording for it. The page marks the scans of a parcel on its way back.

entries.wording: ສົ່ງສຳເລັດ (ເຄື່ອງຕີກັບ)
entries.note: A scan's status COMPLETED with direction BACKWARD, under the tracking page's wording for it. The page marks the scans of a parcel on its way back.
